headline: Labor contract proposal discussions in executive session, plus a Biddeford Music Arts Program memo, enrollment update, and 7th grade overnight field trip.
summary: The agenda lists a labor contract proposal discussion in executive session. It also includes new business on music arts, election day, enrollment, fall athletics, and a field trip to Ecology School.
items: Consent agenda: staff appointments, including a stipends item

Advisory Committee on Curriculum & Instruction report
First reading of overnight field trip for BMS 7th grade to Ecology School
Executive session: labor contract proposal discussions under 1 M.R.S.A § 405(6)D
